semantic_validation_levels.L0_task_understanding: Reviewer distinguishes name/identity label from product implementation and does not leak instructions or provenance metadata into candidate evidence.
semantic_validation_levels.L1_candidate_grounding: Observable claims are grounded in visible spelling or explicitly supplied candidate facts; unsupported etymology/meaning is not treated as fact.
semantic_validation_levels.L2_claim_calibration: Associations, pronunciation, derivation and semantic-fit claims are separated into observed, hypothesis, externally supported, or unknown.
semantic_validation_levels.L3_comparative_reliability: Priority/drop decisions survive controlled order/context perturbation or are downgraded to hold when unstable.
semantic_validation_levels.L4_human_external_validity: Claims about user interpretation, Owner preference, cross-language recovery, trademark/domain/reality, or final adoption use the appropriate human/authoritative evidence.

candidate_generation.purpose: produce exploratory candidates and stated creative intent

semantic_association.purpose: surface possible meanings or user associations for later validation

resource_triage.purpose: conservative priority/hold routing, not quality truth
